summary: render-subsystem helper that formats and renders a text string. Nested guards require a1, a4 and a5 to be nonzero; a5 is copied to v6. Depending on a6, one of two alignment modifiers runs in place on a2: SubtractionWithGuard(a1, a2, &a2, a4) when a6 == 1, or CenterCalc(a1, a2, &a2, a4) when a6 == 2. The tail call sub_553070(a1, a2, a3, v6) commits the render and its result is returned. When any guard fails the function returns an uninitialized value. Subsystem is flagged render; callers are HUD/text display helpers (TimestampedRenderStringUpdate, BrakeWaterTemperatureHUDDisplay, DualTextDisplay).

local_names.a1: render context or destination surface; guards the whole path
local_names.a2: text/position value adjusted in place by the a6-selected modifier
local_names.a3: additional argument forwarded unchanged to the final render call
local_names.a4: bounding or width parameter for the a6-selected modifier; guards the modifier path
local_names.a5: copied into v6 and forwarded to the final render; guards the modifier path
local_names.a6: mode selector: 1 selects SubtractionWithGuard, 2 selects CenterCalc
local_names.v6: ebx copy of a5 forwarded to sub_553070
local_names.result: returned value; uninitialized when any guard fails

operations.description: Outer guard: a1 must be nonzero, otherwise the whole body is skipped
Guard: a4 must be nonzero, otherwise the modifier path is skipped
Guard: a5 must be nonzero; only then is the modifier path entered
v6 = a5: a5 is preserved in ebx for the final render call
Conditional branch a6 == 1: SubtractionWithGuard(a1, a2, &a2, a4) modifies a2 in place (left-align style adjustment)
Conditional branch a6 == 2: CenterCalc(a1, a2, &a2, a4) modifies a2 in place (centering adjustment)
Final stage: sub_553070(a1, a2, a3, v6) commits the formatted/render result and is executed after either modifier branch
Returns the result of sub_553070; on any failing guard path the function returns the uninitialized register value

clean_pseudocode: return result; // uninitialized on guard failure
